bringup-o.address-s: 0x36 (7-bit) / 0x6C write, 0x6D read (8-bit): SADDR not used, GPI2/GPI3 tied to DGND (record cfgpins C2/D2); alternate 0x6E/0x6F with SADDR asserted, or programmed via R0x31FC
bringup-o.id-register-s: NOT STATED (the datasheet gives no chip-version register; it is in the register reference, not local)
bringup-o.check-s: Device ACKs at 0x6C/0x6D; streaming enabled by R0x301A[2] = 1 (power-up step 7) and MIPI CSI-2 output appears
bringup-o.source-s: AR0235 datasheet (confidential, designer-parts/confidential/AR0235CSSC28SMKA0-CP2/): two-wire serial interface addresses p10; power-up sequence Figure 18 p19

datasheet-access-ao.request-s: onsemi: request the AR0235CS datasheet through onsemi sales / your onsemi account (marked CONFIDENTIAL AND PROPRIETARY, NOT FOR PUBLIC RELEASE)
onsemi: part of the AR0235 demo-head package (ar0235_csp62_demo3head_ser); request it with the datasheet

component-o.description-s: AR0235CS 1/2.8-inch 2.3 MP (1920 x 1200) global-shutter CMOS image sensor, RGB Bayer, 28 deg CRA, 120 fps full resolution (10-bit), MIPI CSI-2 1/2/4-lane up to 850 Mbps/lane; 62-ball CSP with protective film, MOQ 50 (-CP2).

specs-o.power_sequence_source-s: onsemi AR0235CS datasheet p19, Power-Up Sequence (Figure 18, Table 15): VAA, VAA_PLL, VAA_PIX (2.8 V) first, together (CSP: same-voltage supplies without delay); VDD_IO, VDD_IO_ANA (1.8 V) t1 >= tr + 100 us after; VDD, VDD_ANA, VDD_PHY (1.25 V) t2 >= tr + 100 us after (tr >= 100 us; delay_min_ms-f counts from the earlier rail being up); then EXTCLK t4 >= 100 us. Table 15's unit glyph is unmapped in the PDF text; step 3 reads 'After 100 us', so us, not ms. Power-down (Table 16) is the reverse; not built.

cfgpins-ao.A6c: Active-low reset/shutdown: drive from a host GPIO, or pull up to VDD_IO (the pin named VDD_IO) when unused (the datasheet requires a pull-up if not driven; value not given, 10k used).

cfgpins-ao.F8c: External input clock, 10-48 MHz (e.g. 24 MHz). Feed from the serializer's CLK_OUT (ds-refclk-tx) or a 1.8 V oscillator; the sensor does not run without it.

cfgpins-ao.E3c: Manufacturing test enable: connect to DGND.

cfgpins-ao.G9c: Analog test access: leave open (floating) for normal operation.

cfgpins-ao.F4c: Analog test access: leave open (floating) for normal operation.

cfgpins-ao.C1c: Unused GPIO0: tie to DGND (onsemi recommendation; may float if never enabled).
